_instructions.description: S3 Lifecycle Policy - Transitions backups to Glacier after 7 days and permanently deletes after 30 days. This provides redundant retention enforcement as a backup to application-level cleanup.
apply_via_aws_console: 1. Navigate to S3 in AWS Console
6. Set scope to apply to all objects or specific prefix
7. Add transition action: Move to Glacier after 7 days
8. Add expiration action: Permanently delete after 30 days
